title: Sell Mineral Rights in Nibbe, MT
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Nibbe, MT
metaDescription: Nibbe, MT is a quiet Yellowstone County farming community with scattered mineral history. I buy fractional interests here based on actual recorded title.
heroLead: Nibbe doesn't show up on most maps of Montana's oil fields, and that's an honest place to start the conversation.
intro: There's no field named after Nibbe and no boom that ever ran through it. It's farmland in Yellowstone County, and the mineral interests I run into out here are almost always tied to old homestead-era severances rather than any recent leasing activity. That doesn't mean an interest here is worthless — it means I evaluate it as ground with limited near-term development likelihood, priced accordingly, rather than pretending there's more upside than the record supports.
I'd rather have that conversation straight than waste a family's time with an inflated first offer that falls apart once I've actually pulled the record.

sections.heading: Honest expectations on rural farmland interests
paragraphs: If your family has held a small mineral interest near Nibbe for generations without ever seeing a royalty check, that's consistent with what I see across this part of the county. I won't tell you it's about to become active just to make a conversation easier. I'll tell you what the record actually shows and what that means for value.

sections.heading: Confirming the chain before I offer anything
paragraphs: I pull the deed history from the Yellowstone County Clerk and Recorder in Billings, confirm the legal description matches what your family believes it owns, and check for any lease of record, expired or active, before I put a number in front of you.

faqs.question: Is there any oil or gas history near Nibbe?
faqs.answer: Very little. This is farmland with no significant field development. I evaluate interests here honestly, based on that reality.

faqs.question: Is it worth selling a mineral interest that's never produced anything?
faqs.answer: It can be, priced as long-term optionality rather than current income. I'll explain the reasoning before making an offer.

faqs.question: How do you confirm what my family owns near Nibbe?
faqs.answer: I pull the recorded chain of title from Yellowstone County records directly and match it against your family's understanding of the parcel.

faqs.question: Would you tell me if my interest isn't worth much?
faqs.answer: Yes. I'd rather give you an honest answer up front than a number that doesn't hold up once the title work is done.

faqs.question: What documents should I gather before calling about a Nibbe interest?
faqs.answer: Whatever you have — an old deed, a probate record, even just a family name and rough location. I fill in the gaps from the county record.
